questions.learningObjective: Relate the mass of a lamina to a double integral
questions.stem: Tonight's group tries to relate the mass of a lamina to the double integral form the group has been revising. Explain the connection.

answer.exemplar: The mass of a lamina of density rho over a region R is the double integral of rho over R, and the double integral of 1 over R is simply the area of R. answer.exemplar: The divergence theorem makes the total outward flux through a closed surface equal to the volume integral of the divergence over the region inside. A field whose divergence vanishes everywhere therefore gives a zero total flux through every closed surface, however strongly it pushes on parts of the surface, because those pushes cancel. questions.hint: One derivative is tied to surfaces, the other to curves.
